title: site_filter
description: KiwiHouseSitters search filters used to build or describe a site search scope.

state.description: KiwiHouseSitters state filter, such as north-island or south-island.

subregion.description: KiwiHouseSitters subregion filter. The site location UI allows one subregion at a time.

sitlengths.description: KiwiHouseSitters sit length filter ID. Used as a fallback split when a location scope is still over the result cap.
